title: Brazilian chocolate truffles - brigadeiro
hookLine: Global-inspired brazilian chocolate truffles - brigadeiro with 7 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Whisk & Combine Base Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: In a medium heavy-based saucepan, heat the butter, condensed milk, a pinch of salt and the cocoa, to boiling, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon. Reduce the heat to medium-low; cook for 10-15 mins, stirring constantly, until the mixture is thick and shiny and starts to pull away from the bottom. Incorporate {m53475_1}, {m53475_2}, {m53475_3}, and {m53475_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure unsalted butter first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Dip & Coat Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Stir in the vanilla and vigorously mix again. Pour the mixture onto a buttered plate. Chill for at least 2 hrs. Whisk steadily around the bottom and corners of the pan until glossy, thickened, and smooth enough to coat the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Combine Wet & Dry Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Fold {m53475_5}, {m53475_6}, and {m53475_7} into the base in two additions using gentle strokes until glossy and uniform with zero dry pockets. Avoid overmixing so the final texture stays light and tender.

steps.title: Shape & Press Dough Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Butter your hands and pinch off some of the dough to make 2.5cm balls. Place your toppings into small bowls and roll the balls of one of the decorations. Place in mini paper baking cups or on a tray lined with non-stick baking paper.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Add a pinch of flaky sea salt right as it leaves the oven—it makes the dark chocolate flavor taste 2x richer.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 15 mins!
